137263d75e06ee43d7fd29d45813ea6e87dafa9c.summary: Medium blog post by an individual author, published 2025-08-18, analysing Qilin ransomware (also called Agenda), a ransomware-as-a-service operation active since July 2022. Covers its affiliate model, attack techniques including double extortion and VMware ESXi targeting, exploited CVEs, notable victims from 2023 to 2025, a Microsoft-reported North Korean link (Moonstone Sleet), and forecasts.

It reports that a leaking channel and two accounts were banned, that a $500,000 bounty in XMR was posted on BreachForums for information on Yukari, and that BreachForums went down after a claimed compromise by law enforcement. The blog says it cannot verify these claims.

13c0a8b3b5d992156ec1044604349fe62fd71f8f.summary: This is a reference index entry for the DistTrack malware family, a wiper. It has no description of its own. It lists titles, dates and authors of third-party articles from vendors and researchers, including CrowdStrike, Fortinet, Symantec, Palo Alto Networks Unit 42, FireEye and Kaspersky, spanning 2012 to 2022. It is an index of references, not a threat report.
